note:
Idle-registry collection, and the extraction that more than paid for it: 4414 -> 4411.

Every unit, measured against HEAD (which reproduces 4414 exactly):

  odoo/tools/config.py::_build_cli                 99 -> 21   excess 19 -> 0   (-19)
  odoo/tools/config.py::_add_file_only_options      -  -> 94   excess  - -> 14  (+14)
  odoo/orm/runtime/registry.py::new                90 -> 92   excess 10 -> 12   (+2)
                                                                          net  -3

`new` grew by the two lines that stamp `last_used` and run `_drop_idle` at the
end of a load. The `registry_idle_timeout` option those need would have added 8
more to `_build_cli`, which was already 19 over -- so the block of file-only
options it belonged to moved into `_add_file_only_options`, the same shape as
the ten `_add_*_options` helpers `_build_cli` already delegates to. That leaves
`_build_cli` a table of contents at 21 lines instead of a list that grows by one
entry per option, and the gate ends up 3 better than before the feature.
